title: Machine learning prediction model for respiratory failure in patients with asthma.
summary: CatBoost was selected from 11 models to predict respiratory failure among 1,405 single-center asthma admissions, with a later temporal cohort from the same institution. Internal validation had AUC 0.796, but recall was 0.302; temporal same-center testing is not external generalization.
ai_technology: CatBoost classifier selected from 11 machine-learning models

evidence.tested: The internal validation AUC was 0.796 with recall 0.302 and specificity 0.987; a later same-center temporal cohort was also assessed.
evidence.unknown: Single-center retrospective design and low internal recall limit interpretation; temporal validation is not external validation or clinical utility.
evidence.ai_role: CatBoost classifier selected from 11 machine-learning models

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
